The CUDA kernel only computes KL contribution when `t > 0.0f && p > 0.0f`:
```cuda
if (t > 0.0f && p > 0.0f) {
    thread_sum += t * (__logf(t) - __logf(p));
```

- **Mutated**: p = 0, so the condition fails and term is **skipped**

This causes significant divergence when targets have positive values at those positions.

- **Mutated**: contribution = 0 (skipped)

Per batch difference: 2048 × 0.00658 ≈ **13.5** (far exceeds tolerance of ~0.01)

The mutation is killable with inputs containing exact zeros in predictions.
